data.description: Before any enforce flip: add an admin-acknowledged exemption ledger (reviewed-equivalent entry, audit metadata, ideally HMAC-signed) that review-coverage-invariant honors via _exempt_has. Without it the first admin bypass after enforce wedges all future PRs (no reachability prefilter; ledger records only proven-reviewed SHAs). Agent-unreachable; admin-only. Test: bypass->exempt->next-PR-passes. Ref: proposal P0.d, scenario S-11.
data.title: S-11: admin-exemption ledger for coverage-invariant (the enforce-flip wedge blocker)
